title: The repressive state: how repression worked
goal: I can describe how military governments used states of siege and secret detention, with the passive with ser.

items: I can say what a state of siege suspended and why governments declared it.
I can describe how security forces watched, arrested and tortured opponents.
I can explain what a clandestine detention centre was.
I can use the passive with ser to say who was watched, suspended or detained.
I can use the new words for repression, guarantees and arrest.
